merger_description:
QL Hotel Op Co Pty Ltd and Waymark Hotels Properties No 45 Pty Ltd, which are part of the Waymark Hotels Group, propose to acquire the land and business of The Queensland Hotel in Goondiwindi, Queensland and the land comprising the nearby motel and residential premises (the **Acquisition**). The Waymark Hotels Group owns and operates hotels (pubs) that provide hospitality services (food and drink, including alcohol), gaming machines, accommodation services, and takeaway liquor retailing (bottle shops). It currently operates pubs and bottle shops in regional Qld and the NT.

The Queensland Hotel is a commercial hotel business located at 134 Marshall Street, Goondiwindi, Qld, which provides hospitality and accommodation services, and has a drive-through bottle shop for the retail service of alcohol. In addition to the accommodation onsite at The Queensland Hotel, there are further motel accommodation facilities at 67 and 71 Bowen Street, Goondiwindi and a residential premises at 73 Bowen Street, Goondiwindi which are on adjoining and adjacent blocks, and which form part of the Acquisition.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers that
the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to material competition
concerns given there is no horizontal overlap between the Waymark
Hotels Group and the Queensland Hotel in the supply of on-premises
and takeaway packaged liquor, dining, gaming and accommodation
services in the area surrounding the Queensland Hotel.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
